- Initially, only Spirit Cultivation is available.
- Body Cultivation unlocks when the player reaches Golden Core I.
- Before unlocking, display Body Cultivation as locked.
- Once unlocked, the player starts at Mortal Body.
- Both paths progress independently.

4. SHARED QI SYSTEM

Both cultivation paths must use the same Qi resource.

- Spirit upgrades consume Qi.
- Body upgrades consume Qi.
- Each path has its own upgrade costs.
- Players decide which path to develop.
- Never create separate Qi currencies.

5. STAGE ADVANCEMENT

- Stages I–IX advance through guaranteed Qi upgrades.
- Stage X is the final stage of each realm.
- Advancing from X to the next realm I requires a major breakthrough.
- Create scalable Qi requirements for all 15 realms.
- Higher realms must become progressively more expensive.

6. MAJOR BREAKTHROUGH SYSTEM

Create separate breakthrough mechanics for Spirit and Body.

Spirit Breakthrough

- Heavenly tribulation challenge.
- Spiritual lightning effects.
- Spirit attributes and Dao comprehension influence success.
- Tribulation Pills and Formation Hall improve success chances.

Body Breakthrough

- Physical tempering challenge.
- Survive damage waves or physical endurance trials.
- Body attributes and Body Tempering Technique influence success.
- Show a different visual effect from Spirit breakthroughs.

Breakthrough outcomes

Success:

- Advance to the next realm at Stage I.
- Award permanent attribute improvements.

Critical Success:

- Advance to the next realm.
- Grant additional permanent attributes or rare rewards.

Failure:

- Remain at the current realm Stage X.
- Lose 10% of accumulated Qi.

Success probability:

- Minimum: 20%.
- Maximum: 95%.
- Include relevant attributes, techniques, pills and sect bonuses.
- Prevent bonuses from being counted multiple times.
